data.summary: The plan front‑loads the weak Unit 4 while ensuring every unit is touched at least once. Live classes are taken in their scheduled weeks, and their topics are woven into the weekly focus. The final two weeks are dedicated to mixed review and timed practice, revisiting all codes and using the remaining classes as reinforcement.

weeks.focus: Kick‑off Unit 4 fundamentals and begin core concepts.
tasks: Read textbook sections on 4.1 and 4.2; create summary charts of reaction types.
Do 10 practice problems on identifying net ionic equations.
Complete 5 free‑response questions on atomic structure (1.5) and self‑grade.

weeks.focus: Live class on early Unit 1; continue Unit 4.
tasks: Watch Class 9700 and take notes on 1.1, 1.2.
Solve 8 mole‑mass conversion problems (1.1).
Practice writing balanced equations for 4.3 representation of reactions.

weeks.focus: Live class on Unit 2; finish Unit 4 stoichiometry.
tasks: Attend Class 9701; focus on 2.1, 2.2.
Complete a worksheet converting between mass, moles, and particles (4.5).
Do 6 FRQs mixing bond types (2.1) with stoichiometric calculations (4.5).

weeks.focus: Intermolecular forces and review Unit 4 basics via two live classes.
tasks: Participate in Class 9702 (3.1, 3.2) and Class 9703 (4.1, 4.2).
Create a comparison table of intermolecular forces vs. reaction types.
Answer 5 FRQs that require identifying physical vs. chemical changes (4.4).

weeks.focus: Kinetics introduction and begin Acid‑Base fundamentals.
tasks: Watch Class 9704; note rate‑law terminology (5.1,5.2).
Calculate reaction rates for 3 sample problems.
Read and summarize 8.1, 8.2; write pH calculations for strong acids/bases.

weeks.focus: Thermochemistry concepts and reinforce Acid‑Base basics.
tasks: Attend Class 9705 covering 6.1, 6.2.
Complete calorimetry lab worksheet (6.1).
Do 8 practice problems on pH/pOH for strong acids/bases (8.2).
Join Class 9706; focus on 7.1, 7.2.
Write equilibrium tables for 3 reactions and determine direction.
Read 9.1, 9.2 and outline entropy concepts in a one‑page cheat sheet.

weeks.focus: Mixed review of all units; reinforce Unit 8 via live class.
tasks: Attend Class 9707 (8.1, 8.2) as a review.
Do a timed set of 12 mixed‑topic FRQs covering the listed codes.
Create a master concept map linking each unit’s key ideas.

weeks.focus: Final timed practice and comprehensive review.
tasks: Watch Class 9708 (9.1, 9.2) quickly to confirm understanding.
Complete a full‑length AP practice section (timed, 90 min) covering all listed topics.
Review incorrect answers and write a one‑page summary of remaining weak spots.

data.final_week_advice: On the last week, simulate exam conditions with a timed practice set, then spend the remaining time polishing answer organization and reviewing any persistent errors. Ensure you get a good night’s sleep before the exam.
